context_map.exchanged_information: Events TelemetrySampleValidated and TelemetrySampleValidationFailed carrying a Telemetry Sample, t_device and validation status; initiated by Ingestion; eventual consistency.
context_map.boundary_protection: Only the two published events cross; Sensor Metric Boundary definitions, backpressure mechanics and t_ingress ordering never leak. Reordering must not re-validate or use t_ingress.

context_map.exchanged_information: Events TelemetrySampleValidated and TelemetrySampleValidationFailed; Event Log appends raw records including VALIDATION_FAILED ones, so nothing is dropped; eventual consistency.
context_map.boundary_protection: Event Log adopts the published sample/status model unchanged and appends it; validation rules stay with Ingestion. Idempotent append keyed by sample identity.

context_map.exchanged_information: Event TelemetryBackfillReconciled describing a backfilled or corrected frame, appended as an Event Revision; eventual consistency.
context_map.boundary_protection: Original records are never modified; only append-revision semantics are exposed. Window buffers and ordering internals never leak.

context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetryWindowEmitted broadcast of chronologically ordered windows to downstream streaming analytics consumers.
context_map.boundary_protection: Stable versioned event contract; consumers cannot reach buffer internals.

context_map.exchanged_information: Raw Ingress Packets from IoT edge devices, bike computers and wearables.
context_map.boundary_protection: Device payloads are translated into Telemetry Samples at the entry point; device-specific formats do not enter the domain model.

cross_boundary_flows.notes: Failure posture: backpressure at entry, at-least-once delivery with idempotent consumption by sample identity. Coupling is one-directional; no cycles.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Append-only audit of samples and revisions
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Flagged: TelemetryRevisionAppended is published but has no consumer in this slice (external auditors/analytics assumed). Flagged for discovery: handling of samples later than the 60s window is unowned between Reordering and Event Log. Invariants each have exactly one owner.
